project_type: Multi-stack starter-kit repository with root-level metadata tooling (Node.js) and 52 independent starter project folders
build_system: pnpm for root metadata validation only; starters are fully independent
test_framework: Vitest with fast-check for property tests (root validator tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile to verify lockfile integrity. 2. Run pnpm catalog:validate to verify catalog/starters.json is valid. 3. Run pnpm test to run validator property tests.
setup_instructions: Node v22+ and pnpm 10+ are pre-installed. Run pnpm install at root to set up validator dependencies (stdlib-only, so minimal).
environment_constraints: Network access available (COMMON_DEPENDENCIES). No Docker daemon needed for root tooling. Validator uses only node:path and node:fs/promises - no external runtime deps.
contribution_requirements: From design.md: Root scripts inspect metadata/files only and never provide source, configuration defaults, test helpers, CSS, schema, or build plugins to a starter. Validator is read-only, Windows-compatible, uses no shell syntax. Status promotion requires all checks to pass.
key_patterns: Validator uses CatalogDiagnostic interface with starter, category, field, expected, observed, correctiveAction, requirement fields. catalog/starters.json has exactly 52 objects with id/folder/family/useCase/framework/runtime/technologies/choices/auth/data/monetization/integrations/readsEnvironment/manifest/lockfile/readme/familyRequirement/status fields. Status is one of: pending, in progress, complete. Root README has validator markers delimiting family sections.
directory_structure: Repository root: README.md, LICENSE, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, catalog/ (starters.json + schema), scripts/ (validate-catalog.mjs), .github/workflows/ (CI), .kiro/ (specs), and 52 starter folders (not yet created)
